# Free and Cheap Tokens (FaCT)

> A curated, **daily human-verified**, machine-readable catalog of **persistent free tiers and limited-time token promos** for AI models and inference services — served as one MCP server over Streamable HTTP.

An open, daily-verified catalog of free AI model API credits, persistent free tiers & limited-time token promotions. 8 MCP tools, MIT, no paid placements.

MCP endpoint: https://neeenja--free-and-cheap-tokens.apify.actor/mcp
Apify Store: https://apify.com/neeenja/free-and-cheap-tokens
Source (MIT): https://github.com/PanStories/free-and-cheap-tokens
Sartbot listing: https://sartbot.com/mcp/free-and-cheap-tokens/
Daily listing page: https://freeandcheaptokens.dev/

## Tools
- search_promos — find offers (free tiers + promos) by provider / region / tag / offer_type
- filter_promos — narrow the catalog by structured criteria (incl. offer_type to isolate free tiers)
- get_promo — full terms for one promo
- list_providers — all providers in the catalog
- get_recent_updates — newly added / changed promos
- get_expiring_soon — promos expiring within N days
- what_can_i_get — reasoned recommendation (premium reasoning)
- report_promo_issue — flag stale / expired data

## Stance
Open source · No paid placements · No affiliate links · Daily verified data · MIT
